_description: Travel data providers available through Firecrawl MCP Alexandria. Use firecrawl_scrape with the 'alexandria' parameter to call these.

hotels/locations.purpose: Resolve destination name to Booking.com dest_id/dest_type

hotels/search.purpose: Search accommodations by destination and dates with live pricing

optional_options.filters: string (e.g. 'ht_id=201' for apartments, 'ht_id=208' for bed and breakfasts)

hotels/search.returns: hotel_id, name, review_score, star_rating, price, country_code, page_name, coordinates

hotels/hotel.purpose: Full property details (description, facilities, policies, house rules)
hotels/hotel.returns: Full property detail including facilities, policies, reviews

hotels/availability.purpose: Room availability and pricing for specific property and dates
hotels/availability.returns: Room offers with prices, cancellation policies, meal plans, rooms_left

hotels/reviews.returns: Review scores, positive/negative text, guest info

vacation-rentals/suggest_destinations.purpose: Resolve place name to Vrbo region_id

vacation-rentals/search.returns: listing_id, name, bedrooms, bathrooms, price, rating, url

vacation-rentals/listing.returns: Full property details, amenities, photos, description

vacation-rentals/quote.returns: Total price, nightly rate, fees breakdown

flights/suggest_places.purpose: Resolve city/airport name to IATA code or Google city ID

flights/search_flights.returns: price, airline, duration, stops, segments, bags_included, booking URLs

flights/suggest_places.purpose: Resolve city/airport to Skyscanner place_id and entity_id

flights/search_flights.purpose: Live flight search with booking links
flights/search_flights.returns: price, airlines, duration, stops, booking URLs with deep links

flights/price_calendar.purpose: Cheapest fare per day for next 12 months (cached indicative)

flights/monthly_prices.purpose: Cheapest fare per month for next 12 months

car-rentals/search.purpose: Search peer-to-peer car rentals by location
car-rentals/search.returns: make, model, year, rating, daily price, total quote, url

car-rentals/vehicle.purpose: Full vehicle details and optional price estimate

seatgeek-com.name: SeatGeek
seatgeek-com.purpose: Search events, venues, performers; ticket availability and price ranges

stubhub-com.name: StubHub
stubhub-com.purpose: Search events, event details, resale ticket offers

tickpick-com.name: TickPick
tickpick-com.purpose: Events discovery, all-in pricing, price history

todaytix-com.name: TodayTix
todaytix-com.purpose: Theater shows, ticket availability, Rush/Lottery info

campspot-com.name: Campspot
campspot-com.purpose: Campground search with availability and pricing

amtrak-com.name: Amtrak
amtrak-com.purpose: Train stations, routes, live tracking (no fares)

travel-state-gov.name: U.S. State Department
travel-state-gov.purpose: Travel advisories (levels 1-4), entry requirements, safety info
